description: Adds RunSignal's workload metrics and spans to the OpenTelemetry .NET SDK with one call, with histogram buckets sized for jobs that run from milliseconds to hours. Send them to New Relic, Grafana, Datadog or any OTLP backend.

Records every Hangfire job run as a RunSignal workload run (success, failure, cancellation and duration) with no code in your jobs. Recurring jobs are named after their ID and their cron schedule is picked up for missed-run alerts.

Zero-dependency core of RunSignal. Records runs, items and heartbeats of background work (scheduled jobs, queue consumers, sync loops) as OpenTelemetry-compatible metrics and spans, so you can alert on work that no HTTP status code describes: missed, overrunning, stalled or low-output jobs.

Reads RunSignal workload manifests and computes when each alert should fire (missed runs from cron schedules, stalled heartbeats, overruns, low output, failure rates), shared by the New Relic and Prometheus backends so every backend alerts at the same moment.

Turns RunSignal workload manifests into Prometheus alerting rules (missed, failed, stalled, overrun, low-output, failure-rate and not-reporting) for Prometheus, Grafana Mimir or any Prometheus-compatible ruler, using the metric names Prometheus gives OpenTelemetry metrics.
Records every Quartz.NET job execution as a RunSignal workload run (success, failure, cancellation and duration) with no code in your jobs. Cron trigger schedules are picked up for missed-run alerts.

Records every Quartz.NET 4 job execution as a RunSignal workload run (success, failure, cancellation and duration) with no code in your jobs. Cron trigger schedules are picked up for missed-run alerts. For Quartz.NET 3, use RunSignal.Quartz.

Registers RunSignal workloads with Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection: AddRunSignal().AddWorkload("nightly-invoice", ...) and inject them with [FromKeyedServices]. Monitor background jobs, consumers and BackgroundService loops that no HTTP status code describes.

The runsignal command: plan, diff and provision New Relic alerts, or export Prometheus alerting rules (missed, overrun, stalled, low-output and failure-rate), for the background jobs listed in RunSignal workload manifests. Idempotent and safe to run in CI.

Turns a RunSignal workload manifest into New Relic NRQL alert conditions (missed, overrun, stalled, low-output and failure-rate) and creates or updates them through NerdGraph, routed by severity to your Teams or Slack workflows.
